log.title: Console
log.empty: Nothing logged yet. Start a run and every step the plugin takes shows up here.

log.footer: Every line also goes to the Dalamud log (/xllog) with the {0} prefix. When reporting a bug, press Copy log and paste the result into the issue.

log.levelTooltip: Click to show or hide these lines. Shift-click to show only this level.
log.sourceChipTooltip: Click to stop filtering by source.

log.copyToEnd: Copy from here to the end
log.hasDetails: Has a stack trace. Select the line to read it.

r2900.1: Added a Shopping tab that spends Wolf Marks and Trophy Crystals at Wolves' Den Pier from your list, with leftover Wolf Marks going to Ventures
r2900.2: Added Steer yourself: you move the character while the plugin keeps targeting, fighting and queueing (settings or /apsg steer)
r2900.3: Improved Human-like play: each match gets its own routes, spacing, gate timing and mount habits, so bots in the same match no longer move in lockstep
r2900.4: Fixed mounting and dismounting over and over, getting stuck on unreachable spots, and walking into the ice in Frontline

r2810.1: Added a Buy Me a Coffee button under Patreon on the About page

r2800.1: Fixed the character stepping backwards while following its team in Frontline
r2800.2: Fixed the character walking back and forth at spawn when a Frontline match starts
r2800.3: Fixed the character standing still while Guard is up; it now keeps moving and only holds its skills
r2800.4: Improved Frontline team following: the bot sticks with ally groups out on the map instead of near your base, and switches groups less often

r2710.1: The combat brain badge now shows your Frontline behavior during Frontline runs instead of the Crystalline Conflict one

r2700.1: Pushing the crystal now walks along with it instead of stopping and restarting every few steps
r2700.2: Each character rides from its own spot in the crystal's circle, so teammates no longer stack on one point
r2700.3: Installing a required plugin that is installed but disabled now enables it instead of breaking its install

r2600.1: Added the Console page to view, filter and copy the plugin's logs
r2600.2: Added this changelog, with a badge whenever an update brings something new
r2600.3: Overhauled the About page, with the updated Discord link

r21000.1: Fixed mounting, taking two steps and dismounting over and over in Frontline when an enemy is close: after an enemy forces a dismount, riding again waits for more room and a longer pause
r21000.2: Fixed Frontline matches idling at a Shatter tomelith with nothing targeted: with no enemy player in reach, the nearest structure within engage range is now attacked, in the team brain and in steer-yourself mode alike
r21000.3: Fixed Black Mage never using Flare Star or Frost Star after Soul Resonance: the rotation now follows the swapped limit break button, and uses the stars directly while Elemental Star is up

r21100.1: Changed the Grind layout to use three mode cards, compact session controls, and directly accessible combat presets and custom settings
r21100.2: Added Casual and Ranked queue selection for Crystalline Conflict
r21100.3: Added Rival Wings infantry support in Hidden Gorge as a preview, with queueing, team following and combat; mechs and map strategy remain manual
r21100.4: Fixed queue retries and match counting: unrelated queues and unconfirmed exits stop the run, and completed matches are counted only once
r21100.5: Fixed navigation cleanup when stopping, timing out or changing destinations, so outdated paths no longer affect movement
r21100.6: Added protected-target filtering and optional Chiten avoidance; Guard lowers target priority while allowing Guard-breaking actions
r21100.7: Changed regrouping to use party and alliance positions when allies are out of view
r21100.8: Fixed moving around the Frontline starting area before the match begins: the character now mounts and waits for the gates to open

r21110.1: Changed mounting up in Frontline to keep running through the mount cast instead of stopping for it. Contributed by Sojiroh

r21120.1: Fixed Ventures not being bought from the Mark Quartermaster: the shopping trip now keeps selecting the shop category until the shop shows it, then searches its tabs
r21120.2: Fixed jumping into the same cliff over and over in Frontline (seen at Worqor Chirteh) and Crystalline Conflict: after one jump the character now backs off beside the snag and takes a new path, and waits there a while if it keeps getting stuck

r21200.1: Added Chat commands to the settings: list your own commands, one per line (such as /li home or /ays m), and they run when a run finishes on its own, before the after-run action, never after Stop or a failure
r21200.2: Filled in text that was missing from every language, including the 2.10.0.0 notes and the Rival Wings and Avoid Chiten settings
r21200.3: The main window now moves only when you drag its top bar, so a drag inside it no longer moves it by accident; turn on Drag from anywhere in the settings for the old behaviour

r21300.1: Added the Limit Break to the plugin itself, so Auto PVP LB is no longer needed: your Auto PVP LB settings carry over the first time this version loads, and the new Limit Break tab in the settings holds the per-job rules, skip filters, allowed duties, blocklist and fire sound
r21300.2: Improved Limit Break timing: the rotation now waits while it goes off, so a skill press can no longer replace it. It still fires in any PvP match, run or not
r21300.3: Fixed the Limit Break's Allowed duties switches doing nothing: Crystalline Conflict, Frontline and Rival Wings were all read as Other PvP
r21300.4: Fixed a blocked player stopping the Limit Break altogether: it now goes to the next enemy instead
r21300.5: Improved role actions: each now fires only when it pays off (Smite on an enemy at 25% HP or lower, Bloodbath below 75% HP, Rampart and Stoneskin II when hurt), and casters' Comet and healers' Haelan and Stoneskin II are used at all
r21300.6: Fixed Bard's Warden's Paean, White Mage's Aquaveil and Samurai's Meikyo Shisui never cleansing while Purify was ready; they now go first, and Purify is kept for Stun, Silence, Deep Freeze and Miracle of Nature
r21300.7: Fixed Viper spending Rattling Coil while Uncoiled Fury and Snake Scales were still ready, which wasted the reset
r21300.8: Fixed Pictomancer keeping Subtractive Palette on while moving, where its spells need a cast; it now drops the palette on the move and picks it back up to cast
r21300.9: Added a conflict check: the grind will not start, and a running grind stops, while a conflicting rotation plugin is loaded
r21300.10: Fixed Finish, then stop and a reached time limit still accepting the next queue pop and playing one more match: a queue that has not popped is now withdrawn and the run ends right away, and Stop withdraws the run's queue too
r21300.11: Fixed a Crystalline Conflict, Frontline or Rival Wings map the plugin did not list yet ending the run as an unrecognized duty: arenas are now also recognized by the game's own content type, so a new map on patch day keeps the grind going
r21300.12: Fixed the run stopping when the game ignored the leave command after a match: the plugin now retries, falls back to the results screen's own leave flow in Crystalline Conflict, and if nothing works asks you to leave by hand and carries on once you are out
r21300.13: Improved Start: when a run cannot start yet (logged out, inside another duty or already in a queue), the ready card and the Start button now say why before you click, instead of one generic chat error afterwards
r21300.14: Added AoE dodging to Frontline and Rival Wings: the bot now steps out of telegraphed enemy attacks and keeps its spot in the formation clear of them, as it already did in Crystalline Conflict; casts from your own side's NPCs no longer count as danger

support.title: Made with love and care
support.body: This plugin is a one-person project, built in my free time because I love this game and its community. Keeping it updated takes a lot of those hours. If it has helped you, supporting me on Patreon or buying me a coffee means I can keep giving it that time. Thank you for being here.
support.hint: Open Patreon, right-click to copy the link.
support.coffeeHint: Open Buy Me a Coffee, right-click to copy the link.

about.linkHint: Click to open, right-click to copy the link.
about.discordBody: Get help, report bugs, share ideas and hear about updates first.
about.githubBody: Browse the source code and every release.

reminder.title: A little reminder
reminder.1: Been at it a while? Roll your shoulders and take one slow breath.
reminder.2: Hydration check. When did you last drink some water?
reminder.3: Blink a few times and let your eyes rest for a moment.
reminder.4: Stand up, stretch, and shake out your hands. Future you says thanks.
reminder.5: Sit up and settle in comfortably. Your back will thank you later.
reminder.6: Remember to eat something today. You matter more than any score.
reminder.7: Eyes feel tired? Look at something far away for twenty seconds.
reminder.8: Whatever you're chasing, you're allowed to take a break whenever.
reminder.9: You're doing great. Be a little kinder to yourself today.
reminder.10: A glass of water and a quick stretch can reset a long session.
reminder.11: Unclench your jaw and drop your shoulders. There you go.
reminder.12: Rest is part of the journey too. Step away whenever you need to.

facts.title: Did you know?
facts.1: Honey never spoils. Jars over 3,000 years old have been found still edible.
facts.2: Octopuses have three hearts and blue blood.
facts.3: A day on Venus is longer than a whole year on Venus.
facts.4: Bananas are berries, but strawberries aren't.
facts.5: There are more possible chess games than atoms in the observable universe.
facts.6: Sharks have been around longer than trees have.
facts.7: A group of flamingos is called a flamboyance.
facts.8: Honeybees can recognize individual human faces.
facts.10: The Eiffel Tower can grow over 15 cm taller on a hot day.
facts.11: Hot water can sometimes freeze faster than cold water.
facts.12: A bolt of lightning is roughly five times hotter than the surface of the Sun.

quotes.title: Words to live by
quotes.1: Done is better than perfect. You can always polish later.
quotes.2: Small steps every day add up to surprising distances.
quotes.3: Comparison is the thief of joy. Run your own race.
quotes.5: You don't have to be great to start, but you have to start to be great.
quotes.6: Be patient with yourself. Growth takes time.
quotes.7: The best time to begin was yesterday. The second best is right now.
quotes.8: Celebrate the small wins. They count too.
quotes.10: Your only real competition is who you were yesterday.

jokes.title: Just for fun
jokes.1: Why don't scientists trust atoms? Because they make up everything.
jokes.2: I would tell you a chemistry joke, but I know I wouldn't get a reaction.
jokes.3: Why did the scarecrow win an award? He was outstanding in his field.
jokes.4: I'm reading a book about anti-gravity. It's impossible to put down.
jokes.5: Why don't skeletons fight each other? They don't have the guts.
jokes.6: What do you call fake spaghetti? An impasta.
jokes.7: Why did the bicycle fall over? It was two tired.
jokes.8: What do you call cheese that isn't yours? Nacho cheese.
jokes.9: I'm on a seafood diet. I see food, and I eat it.
jokes.10: I only know 25 letters of the alphabet. I don't know y.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHelp: The language of this plugin's windows. Job and map names always follow the game client.
settings.dragAnywhereHelp: Move the window by dragging anywhere inside it. When off, only the top bar moves it.

cat.sessionSub: Pacing between matches, and the breaks a person would take.
cat.combatSub: How the bot positions itself and picks its fights.
cat.limitBreakSub: Fires your PvP Limit Break in any PvP match, run or not.
cat.matchSub: The social touches the bot performs during each match.
cat.shoppingSub: Spend Wolf Marks and Trophy Crystals at Wolves' Den Pier.

session.footnote: How long a run lasts and what happens afterwards live on the Grind page, in the plan sentence.
session.leaveDutyHelp: Once the results screen appears, wait this long before leaving the duty. 0 leaves as soon as the match ends.
session.requeueHelp: Waits a random time in this range before queueing the next match; re-queueing the instant a match ends looks robotic. 0 – 0 queues immediately.
session.takeBreaksHelp: Idle for a while every so often, the way a person steps away between sessions.
session.breakLengthHelp: Roughly how long each break lasts, varied by ±20% each time.

postRun.label: Run when the run finishes
postRun.help: One command per line, each starting with a slash. They run when a run ends on its own, before the after-run action, and never after Stop or a failure.
postRun.caption: Lines that do not start with a slash are skipped, so nothing is ever said in chat. Try /li home to head home or /ays m to hand off to AutoRetainer.

combat.introMovement: Behavior controls movement only: where to stand and when to back off.
combat.introRotation: The built-in rotation presses your skills, Guard, Purify, Recuperate and Elixir; the Limit Break fires on its own too, tuned for your class in the Limit Break tab.
combat.rotationPluginHelp: What presses your combat skills during matches.
combat.behaviorHelp: How the bot positions itself and picks its fights.
combat.manualMovementHelp: You move the character and the plugin does the rest: targets, rotation, Limit Break and the queue. It never paths, mounts, dodges or dashes for you, and cast-time skills wait until you stand still. Switch it any time, even mid-match, or type /apsg steer.
combat.reactionTimeHelp: Adds human reaction delays and gives each match its own play style: route, spacing, gate timing and mount habits. Bots in the same match stop moving in lockstep.
combat.recordMatchesHelp: Writes every brain decision (positions, HP, posture, reason) to a per-match log file in the plugin folder,
combat.recordMatchesHelpSize: for reviewing and tuning how it played. Roughly 1 MB per match; only the last 30 matches are kept.
combat.targetingHelp: Who the bot attacks during a fight.

rotation.builtInHelp: This plugin presses your job's PvP skills, Guard, Purify, Recuperate and Elixir itself. Nothing extra to install. The default.
rotation.manualHelp: You press your own skills. The bot still queues, moves, fires the Limit Break and re-queues.
rotation.guardHpHelp: Press Guard when your HP falls under this. Guard cuts 99% of damage for a few seconds and ends as soon as you use another action, so the bot keeps moving but holds its skills while it lasts.
rotation.guardOnBurstHelp: Also Guard earlier, while your HP is dropping fast and at least two enemies are on you.
rotation.guardOnBurstHpHelp: The HP the burst Guard waits for.
rotation.recuperateHelp: Recuperate heals a flat 15,000 for 2,500 MP; the bot presses it once you are missing at least this much.
rotation.elixirHelp: Standard-issue Elixir refills HP and MP fully but takes 4.5 seconds standing still. Used when HP or MP is under this and no enemy is within 25 yards.
rotation.allySupportHelp: Heals, shields and other friendly skills go to the lowest ally under this HP; otherwise to you when you are under it.
rotation.purifyHelp: Clear Stun, Silence, Deep Freeze and Miracle of Nature as soon as they land. Heavy and Bind are left to your job's own cleanse, so Purify stays ready for the next stun.

strategy.rushHelp: No tactics: runs to the objective and stands on it. Never retreats; will feed when outnumbered.
strategy.defensiveHelp: Holds the point without diving, kites when focused, retreats below ~55% HP. Ranged and healers stay far back.
strategy.moderateHelp: Balanced: short chases when ahead, falls back when outnumbered, retreats below ~35% HP. A good default.
strategy.aggressiveHelp: Pushes the enemy line and chases kills; retreats only when nearly dead (~18% HP).
strategy.customHelp: Hand-tuned: every threshold below is yours to set. Starts from the Moderate baseline.

reaction.offHelp: Instant reactions and the shortest route every time. Bots in the same match move alike.
reaction.lightHelp: ~80–220 ms reactions, a little variety in routes, spacing and timing.
reaction.realisticHelp: ~140–380 ms reactions, natural variety in routes, spacing and timing, and hops over small ledges. A good default.
reaction.heavyHelp: ~260–650 ms reactions, wide routes and a clearly unhurried pace.

custom.retreatBelowHelp: When enemies are on you, or your side is outnumbered, and your HP drops under this, fall back to safety.
custom.rejoinAboveHelp: Once you have healed back above this much HP, return to the fight.
custom.alwaysFleeBelowHelp: If your HP drops under this, run for safety no matter what else is happening.
custom.heavyDamageHelp: If your HP is dropping faster than this each second, treat it as taking heavy damage and back off early.
custom.chaseAheadHelp: How much stronger your nearby side must be before you chase a kill. Wounded fighters count for less, and each enemy already dead counts as half a fighter. 0 = chase even fights; below 0 = chase even when slightly outnumbered.
custom.fallBackBehindHelp: How much stronger the nearby enemies must be before you retreat to your team. Wounded fighters count for less. 0 = fall back the moment they outnumber you.
custom.meleeHoldHelp: As melee or tank with no one to chase, how far from the crystal to stand.
custom.meleeChaseHelp: As melee or tank chasing a target, how close to get before attacking.
custom.rangedHoldHelp: As ranged or healer holding position, how far behind the crystal to stand.
custom.rangedAttackHelp: As ranged or healer, how far from your target to stand while attacking.
custom.keepBackHelp: While waiting for teammates to arrive, keep at least this far from the enemy group.
custom.inDangerAtHelp: How many enemies aiming at you before you count as in danger. Works with Retreat below: the more attackers, the sooner you fall back.
custom.sidestepAtHelp: When at least this many enemies are aiming at you, sidestep to safety even at full HP.
custom.sidestepDistanceHelp: When enemies focus you, how far to move in one sidestep, toward whatever spot is safest and closest to your team.
custom.retreatStepHelp: How far each step of a retreat takes you. The direction is chosen to slip past enemies, stay near your team, and break their line of sight.
custom.backupRangeHelp: A teammate within this distance counts as backup. With nobody inside it, you act as if you are alone.
custom.enemyNearRangeHelp: Enemies within this distance of you count toward being outnumbered.
custom.fightZoneHelp: The area around the crystal used to judge who is winning the fight. When no enemy is inside it, the point counts as free and you stand on it to push.
custom.maxChaseHelp: Never chase a target further than this from the crystal. Enemies past it are ignored.
custom.maxFromTeamHelp: Never wander further than this from the middle of your team.
custom.resetDefaultsHelp: Sets every value above back to the Moderate baseline. Hold Ctrl and click to confirm.

match.sayHelloHelp: Sends /quickchat Hello once during the portrait phase, at a random moment so it doesn't look scripted.
match.helloChanceHelp: How often the hello actually fires. Lower means it sometimes stays silent.
match.helloAfterHelp: Waits a random time in this range after the portraits appear, so the greeting never fires the instant the intro starts.
match.emotesHelp: Plays a random friendly emote (wave, cheer, salute, and the like) at a random moment of the pre-match countdown, sometimes twice. Waits until your character is free so the emote actually plays.
match.goodMatchHelp: Sends /quickchat "Good Match" when the results screen appears at the end of a match.
match.goodMatchChanceHelp: How often "Good Match" actually fires after a match.
match.goodMatchAfterHelp: Waits a random time in this range after the results screen appears. If it lands later than "Leave duty after" (under Session), the bot leaves first and skips the goodbye.

targeting.smartHelp: Weighs low HP, the team's focus target, squishy roles (healers first), distance and Guard, and sets the pick as your target.
targeting.lowestHpHelp: The enemy with the least HP within 25 yards, skipping anyone with Guard up while someone else is available.
targeting.currentHelp: Attacks whatever you have targeted and only picks for itself when you have nothing targeted.
targeting.avoidChitenHelp: Skip enemies protected by Chiten when selecting targets, chasing, or using offensive actions.

frontline.behaviorHelp: How the bot moves with its team in Frontline.
frontline.defensiveHelp: Sticks to the back of the group, falls back below ~55% HP and keeps well clear of the enemy line.
frontline.moderateHelp: Holds a normal spot in the group and falls back below ~45% HP or when two enemies focus you. A good default.
frontline.aggressiveHelp: Stands at the very front of the group, shrugs off focus longer and falls back only below ~30% HP.
frontline.customHelp: Hand-tuned: every Frontline distance and threshold below is yours to set. Starts from the Moderate baseline.

rivalWings.behaviorHelp: Infantry formation, retreat and mounting. Shares your large-scale PvP behavior settings.

frontlineCustom.position: Where to stand in the group
frontlineCustom.frontOffsetHelp: As melee or tank, how far ahead of the group's centre toward the enemy to stand.
frontlineCustom.backOffsetHelp: As ranged or healer, how far behind the group's centre to stand.
frontlineCustom.retreatOffsetHelp: When hurt or focused, how far behind the group's centre to retreat.
frontlineCustom.regroupDistanceHelp: If you drift farther than this from the group, everything else waits until you are back with it.
frontlineCustom.engageRangeHelp: Only enemies this close count as targets; nobody is chased beyond the group.
frontlineCustom.hurtBelowHelp: Under this HP you move behind the group until you recover.
frontlineCustom.focusedHurtBelowHelp: When enough enemies aim at you (see In danger at), fall back already at this HP.
frontlineCustom.recoverAboveHelp: Once healed above this, take your spot in the group again.
frontlineCustom.mountDistanceHelp: After a respawn or a split, mount up for the ride back when the group is about this far away. Each match varies it a little.
frontlineCustom.enemyAwareHelp: An enemy this close means no mounting, and dismount at once.

shop.betweenMatchesHelp: Before queueing again, head to Wolves' Den Pier once Wolf Marks reach the threshold, or once a Trophy Crystal item on your list is affordable. The next match is queued from the pier.
shop.thresholdHelp: Go shopping once you hold at least this many Wolf Marks. They cap at 20,000, and marks earned past the cap are lost.
shop.goNowHelp: Teleports to Wolves' Den Pier and buys from your list right away, ignoring the threshold. Available while no run is active.
shop.nothingToBuy: Nothing to buy right now: the list is done or you cannot afford anything on it.
shop.wallet: You have {0:N0} Wolf Marks and {1:N0} Trophy Crystals.
shop.addItemHelp: Everything the Wolf Mark and Trophy Crystal vendors at Wolves' Den Pier sell.
shop.listHelp: Bought top to bottom until the currency runs out. One-time unlocks are bought once; everything else keeps buying or stops at the count you set.
shop.catalogEmpty: Could not read the vendors' stock from the game data.
shop.leftoverItemHelp: After the list, Wolf Marks above the reserve go to this item. Ventures are the usual pick.
shop.reserveHelp: Never spend Wolf Marks below this amount.
shop.footnote: Ventures cost 100 Wolf Marks each. Shopping needs the Wolves' Den Pier aetheryte attuned.
shop.chatNothingBought: The shopping trip ended without buying anything. /apsg log has the details.
shop.chatBusy: Shopping skipped: finish the duty, fight or queue first.

plugin.commandHelp: Toggle the Auto PVP Series Grind window. /apsg config | stats | deps | log | changelog | about | target | objects | steer.
plugin.steerOn: You steer now. The plugin keeps targeting and fighting.

setup.rankedWaiting: Waiting for a ranked Crystalline Conflict match.
setup.sharedBehavior: Frontline & Rival Wings share these behavior settings.
setup.conflictBehavior: Choose a movement preset or tune your own.
setup.manualBehavior: Manual movement is on. Turn it off in combat settings to use these presets.
setup.legacyBehavior: Rush mode is active. Choose a preset to enable tactical movement.
setup.customParametersHelp: Changes save automatically. Switching presets keeps your custom values.
setup.combatLocked: Combat settings are locked during a run. Manual movement can still be changed live.
setup.seriesGoalHint: Series reward rank, separate from your competitive Ranked tier.
setup.afterEndless: After-run actions apply when a session goal is reached.

limitBreak.enabled: Fire the Limit Break for me
limitBreak.enabledHelp: Fires your job's PvP Limit Break when the rule below is met, in any PvP match, whether or not a run is going. It also works when you press your own skills or steer yourself.
limitBreak.legacyLoaded: The old Auto PVP LB plugin is still loaded, so the built-in Limit Break stays off to avoid firing twice. Its settings were copied here; disable it to switch over.
limitBreak.noJob: Log into a job to set a per-job rule. The rule you set here applies only while that job is active.
limitBreak.presetNote: This is the tuned preset for {0}. Change anything below to make it your own rule.
limitBreak.customNote: You changed this rule. Reset to preset puts the tuned values back.
limitBreak.modeHelp: Offensive LBs fire on a low enemy. Defensive and utility LBs are self-cast and fire on team conditions instead.
limitBreak.offensiveBlurb: Fires on a hostile below an HP threshold.
limitBreak.defensiveBlurb: Fires (self-cast) when your team is pressured: enough hurt allies nearby and enemies present.
limitBreak.utilityBlurb: Fires (self-cast) in a committed teamfight: enough allies and enemies clustered, regardless of HP.
limitBreak.thresholdTypeHelp: Percent scales with every target's max HP. Absolute fires below a fixed amount of HP, whatever the target's max.
limitBreak.fireBelowPercentHelp: The LB fires once a target's HP, shields included, drops below this share of its max HP.
limitBreak.fireBelowAbsoluteHelp: The LB fires once a target's HP, shields included, drops below this many points.
limitBreak.previewPercent: Fires when the target drops below {0}% of its max HP.
limitBreak.previewAbsolute: Fires when the target drops below {0} HP.
limitBreak.allyHpHelp: An ally counts as hurt below this share of max HP.
limitBreak.hurtAlliesHelp: Fire when at least this many hurt allies are nearby.
limitBreak.alliesNearHelp: Fire when at least this many allies are clustered nearby.
limitBreak.allyRadiusHelp: How close an ally must be to count.
limitBreak.enemiesNearHelp: Also require this many enemies within range.
limitBreak.enemyRadiusHelp: How close an enemy must be to count.
limitBreak.skipDoomed: Skip targets that will die first
limitBreak.skipDoomedHelp: If an enemy is losing HP fast enough to die before the LB lands (about a 1.2 s cast lock), skip it so the charge isn't wasted on a kill someone else gets.
limitBreak.skipGuardedHelp: Guard reduces incoming damage by 90% for 5 s. The LB would land for about 10% and waste the charge, so guarded targets are skipped.
limitBreak.skipInvulnerable: Skip targets immune to your LB
limitBreak.skipInvulnerableHelp: Paladin's Phalanx LB (Hallowed Ground) and Dark Knight's Eventide LB (Undead Redemption) make the target immune to damage for 10 s. The LB can't kill them, so these targets are skipped.
limitBreak.dutyFootnote: Auto-fire only runs in the PvP modes switched on here.
limitBreak.blocklistAddHelp: Type an exact player name and press Enter. Blocked players are never auto-targeted.
limitBreak.playSoundHelp: Plays a chat sound effect (the same set as /se1 to /se16) each time the LB fires.
limitBreak.soundEffectHelp: Which of the sixteen chat sound effects to play.
limitBreak.logToChatHelp: Prints a line to chat when an LB fires, for example "fired Seiton Tenchu on Striking Dummy".

conflicts.title: Rotation Solver Reborn detected
conflicts.detail:
RSR is a vibe-coded AI slop plugin that could potentially harm your computer.

Its drama-loving developer spreads lies about us, falsely claiming that Auto PvP uses RSR. Auto PvP does not use RSR and has its own independent combat logic and rotations.

RSR's weak PvP combat logic and rotations conflict with ours. For the best experience, disable RSR to continue automation.
